hypothesised_pattern: The base model misses a multiplicative interaction between x2 and x5: the target exceeds the prediction when x2 and x5 have the same sign and falls short when they differ.
rationale: All eight positive residuals (+0.15 to +0.16) have x2*x5 > 0, including both both-positive pairs (1.946, 0.763) and both-negative pairs (-1.795, -1.783). The two negative residuals have x2*x5 < 0 (-0.227*0.756 and 2.474*-0.320), so the residual sign follows the product rather than either feature alone.
